cross_saveat.interpretation: All cases remain within the single frozen continuous reference and within cross-saveat tolerance. A small solver/output-grid numerical spread remains, but it is orders of magnitude smaller than the management-reoptimization effect qualified in DUMMY-19G.

qualified_claims: Repeated saveat-synchronized allocation solves do not change the allocation map when supply already satisfies the full 40/20 m3/day demand.
All four saveat cases remain within the same preregistered physical-volume and endpoint tolerances.
The large DUMMY-19G saveat sensitivity therefore requires state-dependent management reoptimization of retained storage; it is not explained by output-saving/numerical-grid effects alone.
A small residual numerical saveat sensitivity remains and should not be described as exact bitwise hydrological invariance.
boundaries: This negative control isolates the dominant mechanism but does not claim mathematically exact saveat invariance.
downstream: Proceed to preregistered DUMMY-19I BMI-owned 6-hour management clock.
